parameters.query: SELECT json_build_object('stats',(SELECT row_to_json(s) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS orders, round(sum(total_amount),2) AS total_spent, round(avg(total_amount),2) AS avg_order, max(order_date)::date AS last_order FROM orders) s),'burndown',(SELECT json_agg(b) FROM (SELECT cm.product_name, cm.observed_intervals AS seen, cm.last_purchased::date AS last_bought, round(cm.avg_days_between,1) AS avg_days, round(cm.days_until_depletion,1) AS days_left FROM consumption_metrics cm WHERE cm.observed_intervals>=3 ORDER BY cm.days_until_depletion ASC LIMIT 40) b),'recent',(SELECT json_agg(r) FROM (SELECT o.order_date::date AS d, o.total_amount AS amt FROM orders o ORDER BY o.order_date DESC LIMIT 10) r),'monthly',(SELECT json_agg(m) FROM (SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month',order_date),'YYYY-MM') AS ym, round(sum(total_amount),2) AS spent FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 6) m)) AS data;

nodes.name: Gemini
nodes.notes: Create a Header Auth credential: Name = x-goog-api-key, Value = your Gemini API key (aistudio.google.com/apikey). Free tier is plenty for weekly.

nodes.name: Publish to app
nodes.notes: Reuse the same GitHub credential as the data-push workflow. The app reads insights.json automatically.
